rule.message:
All degree-seeking students must complete the University’s  Liberal Education requirements .
All freshmen in the College of Science and Engineering must complete CSE 1001: First-Year Experience.
At least 19 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
View  Four-year Plans  for the College of Science and Engineering. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

Admission to a major in the College of Science & Engineering is a competitive process based on the successful completion of specific technical courses and a grade point average (GPA) based on technical courses (the technical GPA ).
Students who have completed the necessary technical courses and have a 3.2 or above technical GPA at the end of the fall semester will be guaranteed admission to that major. All other students who have completed the necessary technical coursework for their intended major (as identified by each department) will be considered for admission to that major on a space-available basis.
Students are eligible to apply once they have met the following minimum requirements for prerequisite courses and technical GPA.
Students must have completed or be currently enrolled in specific courses with a grade of C- or better. Those courses are a calculus introductory core sequence (Calc I and Calc II), a course in discrete structures, and a computer science introductory core sequence (CS I option and CS II option).
For more information on the application to the major process for the Computer Science BS program, visit the CS&E Computer Science BS Application website . Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
